Asha (People Ops): quick live-thread from the all-hands Q&A 1: a few follow-ups on market adjustments, equity refresh timing, and open enrollment exceptions. dropping answers and owners. pls add anything I missed. :clipboard:
Tom (Eng): thanks. team asked if market adjustments (we mentioned a small pool) will hit before comp cycle or after? some people assumed "extra merit".
Asha (People Ops): short answer: market adjustments are distinct from merit. pool is for targeted market gaps and will be processed the pay period after approvals (not merged into merit ratings). Marta will own the calibration list.
Marta (Comp): yes i'll publish the eligible roles list by EOW. adjustments are data-driven (benchmarks + internal compression) and require manager justification + comp sign-off.
Rae (IC): equity refresh question: when should managers start conversations about refresh timing? Is there a standard window?
Asha (People Ops): refresh conversations should start 30-60 days before the candidate/employee's refresh eligibility date. Recruiting + manager coordinate for messaging. we'll add a short checklist for managers.
Liam (Recruiting): onboarding note: for hires with promised refresh or sign-on equity in offers, do we record that somewhere special? had one case where promises were verbal.
Asha (People Ops): please record any equity/sign-on commitments in Greenhouse Offer Notes and attach the Award Plan snippet. that creates an audit trail. we'll push a one-line template.
Marta (Comp): also note: refresh pools are discretionary and based on performance + headcount budget. we try to be transparent but can't promise refresh until approvals complete.
Tom (Eng): comp compression: people asked about narrow band spans and how we address long-tenured folks being squeezed by market.
Marta (Comp): good point. we handle via targeted market adjustments and refactoring of bands where necessary. long-tenured compression cases get prioritized if impact on retention risk is high. managers should flag in the "comp exceptions" form.
Rae (IC): open enrollment exception: if someone misses the enrollment window due to medical leave, can they enroll mid-year?
benefits-bot: Benefits rule: qualifying life events (QLEs) permit mid-year enrollment. People Ops + Benefits team must receive documentation within 30 days of the event.
Asha (People Ops): correct 1: QLEs are the path. we'll add an example list (birth, marriage, loss of coverage) to the handbook. tag me for help.
Liam (Recruiting): one more hiring-edge: when an external candidate negotiates a higher salary + earlier refresh, do we create an exception or shift band?
Marta (Comp): create an exception addendum. do not change band structure for a single hire. document override and a plan to normalize if needed. sample language: "temporary override to base and refresh schedule; all other band guardrails remain."
Rae (IC): appeals or recalibration if someone believes market adjustment missed them?
Asha (People Ops): appeals: start with manager conversation. if unresolved, submit a comp exception form within 21 days of the adjustment announcement. People Ops + Comp will review.
Asha (People Ops): i'll consolidate these snippets into a short handbook update and a one-pager for managers. ETA: publish draft by next Tue and host a 20-min Q&A after. :calendar:
